```{r}
#MI
library(tidyverse)
library(missRanger)

# 看维度
dim(df_selected)

# 每列缺失比例
miss_pct <- sort(colMeans(is.na(df_selected)), decreasing = TRUE)
head(miss_pct, 30)

# 看哪些列缺失 > 0
miss_pct[miss_pct > 0]
id_col <- "id"
time_col <- "wave"
outcome_col <- "frailty"
# 1) 分类列先做众数插补（保持和 Python 一致）
df2 <- df_selected %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

cat_cols <- names(df2)[sapply(df2, is.factor) | sapply(df2, is.logical)]
mode_impute_factor <- function(x){
  if (!is.factor(x)) x <- as.factor(x)
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  tab <- table(x, useNA="no")
  if (length(tab)==0) return(x)
  m <- names(tab)[which.max(tab)]
  x[is.na(x)] <- m
  droplevels(x)
}
for (c in cat_cols) df2[[c]] <- mode_impute_factor(df2[[c]])

# 2) 不插补 id/wave/frailty（但可以作为预测器）
never <- intersect(c(id_col, time_col), names(df2))

set.seed(1234)
df_imp <- missRanger(
  df2,
  formula = as.formula(
    paste0(". ~ . - ", paste(c(never, outcome_col), collapse = " - "))
  ),
  pmm.k = 5,
  maxiter = 10,
  num.trees = 200,
  verbose = 1
)

# 3) 把不插补列覆盖回原值
for (v in intersect(c(id_col, time_col, outcome_col), names(df_imp))) {
  df_imp[[v]] <- df2[[v]]
}

write.csv(df_imp, file = "CHARLS插补完数据.csv")
```

miss_pct[miss_pct > 0]

#FI calc
```{r}
# ── 变量说明（所有变量已预编码为0/1，1=存在缺陷）──────────────────────────
# 慢性病（da003_*）：1=患有该病
#   da003_1_  高血压
#   da003_3_  糖尿病
#   da003_4_  癌症
#   da003_5_  肺部疾病
#   da003_6_  心脏病
#   da003_8_  关节炎/风湿
#   da003_11_ 肾脏疾病
#   da003_12_ 胃肠疾病
#   da003_14_ 精神/记忆相关疾病
#
# 自评健康（da001）：1=差/不好（deficit）
#
# ADL功能障碍（db001~db009）：1=有困难（deficit）
#   db001 穿衣  db003 洗澡  db005 进食  db007 上下床  db009 如厕
#
# IADL功能障碍（db014~db022）：1=有困难（deficit）
#   db014 做家务  db016 做饭  db022 购物
#
# 体力活动（exdb025）：1=不运动/静态生活（deficit）
#
# 认知功能（cognition）：连续变量0~1，值越高认知越差

# ── 构建 Frailty Index ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 定义所有deficit项目
chronic_vars <- c("da003_1_", "da003_3_", "da003_6_", "da003_8_",
                  "da003_4_", "da003_14_", "da003_5_", "da003_11_", "da003_12_")

adl_vars  <- c("db001", "db003", "db005", "db007", "db009")
iadl_vars <- c("db014", "db016", "db022")

all_binary_vars <- c(chronic_vars, "da001", adl_vars, iadl_vars, "exdb025")
# 共19个二值变量 + 1个连续认知变量 = 20项

df <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(c(all_binary_vars, "cognition")), as.numeric),
    
    # 计算有效项目数（分母随缺失值动态调整）
    n_valid = rowSums(!is.na(select(., all_of(all_binary_vars)))) +
              as.numeric(!is.na(cognition)),
    
    # 计算deficit总分（NA自动跳过）
    deficit_sum = rowSums(select(., all_of(all_binary_vars)), na.rm = TRUE) +
                  ifelse(is.na(cognition), 0, cognition),
    
    # FI = 总缺陷 / 有效项目数（至少需要非NA项目数≥0.7×20=14项）
    FI = ifelse(n_valid >= 14, deficit_sum / n_valid, NA_real_),
    
    # 二值化：FI≥0.25定义为frail（论文标准）
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(FI)  ~ NA_real_,
      FI >= 0.25 ~ 1,
      TRUE       ~ 0
    )
  )

# ── 检查结果 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(df$FI)
table(df$frailty, useNA = "ifany")
prop.table(table(df$frailty, useNA = "no"))  # frail比例
```


##从原数据构建frailty(2018)

```{r}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Import the data
df_hmn<- read_dta("/Users/jennyzhu/Desktop/1. Work/1. Social Economic/H_CHARLS_D_Data.dta")
df_2018 <- read_dta("/Users/jennyzhu/Desktop/1. Work/1. Social Economic/2018/Health_Status_and_Functioning.dta")

```

```{r}
hs <- df_hmn %>%
  select(
    ID, r4hibpe,r4diabe,r4hearte,r4stroke,r4cancre,r4arthre,r4lunge,r4psyche,r4memrye,r4shlta,
    
    r4dressa,r4batha,r4eata,r4beda,r4toilta,r4mealsa,r4shopa,r4moneya,r4medsa,
    
    r4walk1kma,r4chaira,r4climsa,r4stoopa,r4armsa,r4lifta,r4dimea
  )

hs <- hs %>%
  mutate(r4shlta = case_when(
    r4shlta %in% c(1,2,3) ~ 0,
    r4shlta %in% c(4,5) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

df_2018 <- df_2018 %>%
  select(ID,da005_3_, da005_4_)
vars <- c("da005_3_", "da005_4_")
df_2018 <- df_2018 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars), ~ ifelse(. == 2, 0, .)))

cog <- read_excel("/Users/jennyzhu/Desktop/1. Work/1. Social Economic/2018认知抑郁.xlsx")

cog <- cog %>%
  rename(
    id              = ID,
    immediate       = `即时单词记忆2018`,
    delayed         = `延时单词记忆2018`,
    serial7         = `100减去7实验2018`,
    year_           = `年2018`,
    season          = `季节2018`,
    day_            = `日2018`,
    weekday         = `星期几2018`,
    month_          = `月2018`,
    figure          = `画图2018`
  )

cog <- cog %>%
  mutate(
    # 第一步：转为numeric（字符串"NA"自动变成真正的NA）
    across(c(immediate, delayed, serial7,
             year_, season, day_, weekday, month_, figure),
           as.numeric),

    # 第二步：单项NA替换为0（视作该题得0分）
    # 但先记录哪些人是全部NA（代理访谈）
    n_valid = rowSums(!is.na(select(., immediate, delayed, serial7,
                                     year_, season, day_, weekday, month_, figure))),

    across(c(immediate, delayed, serial7,
             year_, season, day_, weekday, month_, figure),
           ~ replace_na(., 0)),

    # 第三步：计算各分项
    date_naming = year_ + season + day_ + weekday + month_,
    total       = immediate + delayed + serial7 + date_naming + figure,

    # 第四步：公式不变，但全部NA的人（n_valid==0）或total==0设为NA
    cognition = ifelse(
      n_valid == 0 | total == 0,
      NA_real_,
      (total - (immediate + delayed + date_naming)) / total
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, cognition) %>%
  rename(ID = id)


#merge
df_merged <- hs %>%
  full_join(df_2018, by = "ID") %>%
  full_join(cog, by = "ID")

write.csv(df_merged, file = "df.csv")
```

#Frailty calc
```{r}
# ── 变量定义（根据实际列名）──────────────────────────────────────────────
# 慢性病（9项）
chronic_vars <- c("r4hibpe",   # 高血压
                  "r4diabe",   # 糖尿病
                  "r4hearte",  # 心脏病
                  "r4stroke",  # 中风
                  "r4cancre",  # 癌症
                  "r4arthre",  # 关节炎/风湿
                  "r4lunge",   # 肺部疾病
                  "r4psyche",  # 精神疾病
                  "r4memrye")  # 记忆相关疾病
 
# 自评健康（1项）
srh_vars <- c("r4shlta")
 
# ADL 日常活动能力（5项）
adl_vars <- c("r4dressa",   # 穿衣
              "r4batha",    # 洗澡
              "r4eata",     # 进食
              "r4beda",     # 上下床
              "r4toilta")   # 如厕
 
# IADL 工具性日常活动能力（4项）
iadl_vars <- c("r4mealsa",  # 做饭
               "r4shopa",   # 购物
               "r4moneya",  # 管钱
               "r4medsa")   # 管药
 
# 体能功能（7项）
physical_vars <- c("r4walk1kma",  # 步行1km
                   "r4chaira",    # 从椅子起来
                   "r4climsa",    # 爬楼梯
                   "r4stoopa",    # 弯腰/蹲下
                   "r4armsa",     # 手臂上举
                   "r4lifta",     # 举重物
                   "r4dimea")     # 捡硬币/精细动作
 
# 其他（2项）
other_vars <- c("da005_3_",  # 视力相关或其他
                "da005_4_")  # 视力相关或其他
 
# 所有二值变量（共28项）
all_binary_vars <- c(chronic_vars, srh_vars, adl_vars, iadl_vars, 
                     physical_vars, other_vars)
 
# 认知（1项连续变量，已在0~1之间，值越高认知越差）
# 共 28 + 1 = 29 项，70%阈值 = floor(29*0.7) = 20 项
 
# ── 逐行逐变量计算（NA则分子分母均不纳入）────────────────────────────────
df <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(all_binary_vars, "cognition")), as.numeric),
         cognition = pmin(pmax(cognition, 0), 1)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # 分母：仅统计非NA的项目数
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(c_across(all_of(all_binary_vars)))) +
              as.integer(!is.na(cognition)),
    
    # 分子：仅累加非NA项目的deficit值
    deficit_sum = sum(c_across(all_of(all_binary_vars)), na.rm = TRUE) +
                  ifelse(is.na(cognition), 0, cognition),
    
    # FI = 分子 / 分母（NA项在两者中均被跳过）
    FI = ifelse(n_valid > 0, deficit_sum / n_valid, NA_real_),
    
    # 三分类
    frailty_cat = case_when(
      is.na(FI)  ~ NA_character_,
      FI >= 0.25 ~ "frail",
      FI >= 0.10 ~ "pre-frail",
      TRUE       ~ "robust"
    ),
    
    # 二值
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(FI)  ~ NA_real_,
      FI >= 0.25 ~ 1,
      TRUE       ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── 检查结果 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(df$FI)
table(df$frailty_cat, useNA = "ifany")
prop.table(table(df$frailty_cat, useNA = "no"))


write.csv(df, file = "charls_frailty_2018.csv")
 
```
